scope: Account PRD subaccounts section0: external EOA login required for creation; embedded Privy creation forbidden.

source.section_snapshot:
### 0、创建子账户的前提条件

只有通过eoa钱包登录的账户，可以创建子账户

通过privy托管钱包登录的用户，不允许创建子账户

implementation.eligibility: Current authenticated AuthIdentity.walletKind must be external. Linked email does not deny external EOA creation; a merely connected unrelated wallet does not grant embedded identity permission.
implementation.ui: Create remains selected initially and disabled for embedded wallets, with EN/ZH explanation; no automatic selection of freeze, unfreeze or transfer. Creation fields/prepare disabled; stale creation review hidden.
implementation.application: Prepare rejects embedded creation before repository calls. Confirm independently rejects embedded creation. Identity id/address/walletKind/signingAvailable/auth busy and generation participate in scope checks. Returned identity never revives older callbacks.
implementation.repository: Prepare and submit reject embedded creation before signing, transport or journal writes. Signing availability also required. Existing child proof, fresh signed master qualification/count, ten-child limit,45sec review, signature verification and persist-before-POST retained.
implementation.switch: Separate explicit switch address input and confirmation remain usable for embedded identity while creation is disabled; identity or signing capability changes clear entered addresses/name/amount/child proof.
implementation.other_actions: Embedded list/read, management entry, switching, freeze/unfreeze and master-child four market-direction transfers remain available subject to signing capability and Aster master authorization; successful synthetic responses do not prove actual acceptance.
implementation.wallets: Existing EOA signs directly as user=signer; no wallet/key generation or replacement agent. Child EOA independently owned and signs existing challenge.

architecture.extraction: Localized action selector extracted. Existing management screen's long orchestration build reviewed: creation capability is domain helper, transport/signing guards in application/data, review separate part; no new HTTP or financial logic in widgets.

coverage: Embedded creation both signable/restored: no signature/HTTP/journal; valid child proof cannot bypass forged embedded review.
External EOA with email allowed; disconnected EOA blocked; embedded freeze/unfreeze and all8 transfer direction/from-to combinations remain accepted by synthetic master.
Preparation/submission scope invalidated by wallet kind/signing/logout/stop; return to same EOA requires fresh generation; old confirm cannot send.
Independent confirm guard against unexpected embedded creation review.
EN/ZH320width text1.5,844x390landscape,768tablet; actual dropdown operation and explicit confirm for other actions.
Same-address EOA→Privy clears child proof/inputs, hides challenge/confirm; separate switching confirmation and explicit list read still usable.

boundaries: Real EOA self-agent acceptance, embedded noncreation operation qualification, child account creation and financial results unverified.
No device tooling/APK installation or real signatures/private/financial/chat/address-bearing RPC requests in this increment.
Android normal Makefile build only. iOS needs macOS/Xcode.
Full PRD goal still active: complete strategy management, Chase recovery, nine-mode entry/default settings, full Portfolio and Swap incomplete. User skipped only historical statistics/Summary/TWAP.
